name: lumiere
description: Lumiere - macOS video player built with Electron, Vue and TypeScript

scripts.build:native:x64: node scripts/build_native.cjs x64 && node -e "if(process.platform==='darwin')require('child_process').execSync('bash fix_native_rpaths.sh x64',{stdio:'inherit'})"
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack: npm run build && npm run build:native && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:native && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:unsigned: npm run build && npm run build:native && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --arm64 --config.mac.identity=null
scripts.test:domain:
echo 'Domain model testing methods:

Method 1 (recommended): Use IPC commands
  1. Run: npm run dev
  2. In the renderer process console run: window.electronAPI.send('test-semantic-refactoring')
  3. Check main process console output

Method 2: Dev mode auto-test
  Run: NODE_ENV=development npm run dev
  Tests run automatically, check main process console

For detailed instructions see: docs/guides/TESTING_GUIDE.md'
